pr_title: statistics: fix stack overflow when use DNF expr immediately after add column
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #22134

Problem Summary:

After ADD COLUMN operation, stats may not be updated immediately so it doesn't contain the new column.
In this case, conditions containing this column can't be handled in `Selectivity()`.
But in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/18741, when handling DNF condition, we used a recursive method and overlooked this possibility.

### What is changed and how it works?

We added 2 checks.
1. Check if the column in this DNF condition is indeed in the stats.
2. Check if the DNF conditions contain more than 1 column.

Only when both of them satisfied should we recursively call `Selectivity()` to handle this condition.

Each check should fix this issue respectively, but I think it's better to have both of them to prevent some unexpected cases.

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
- Integration test

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- no release note.
